survivor_sprite.note: Hooded leather painted sprite, mirrored to its facing; one frame cut from a ~60 px preview, so it's soft, and the sword and torch are still primitive rods

enemy_sprites.note: Nine creature classes are painted with distinct silhouettes; the bog-bull, skull-deer, crows and rot mounds are still primitives, and nothing animates

telegraph_poses.note: Single-frame sprites: telegraphs still rely on the coloured status rings

stone_walls.note: Walls carry a painted stone texture, but they're still straight boxes with no crumbling or damage variants

wet_ground.note: A painted ground texture, but flat and faint: no flagstone, moss, mud or puddle sheen

props.note: Painted chest, stash, crates, sacks and campfire; no barrels placed, banner, collapsed timbers or leaning shield

torch_light.note: Warm torch pool with fast falloff, and a dim blue-grey ambient now reads outside it; no wet highlights

fire_vfx.note: The campfire is a painted still; torch flames are emissive spheres; no flipbooks

backdrop.note: No mist or pines beyond the walls

palette_discipline.note: Sprites are muted and earthy, but the status rings still add saturated colour

pack_grid.note: The pack is still a list (now with icons)

pack_detail.note: No detail pane; Use/Drop buttons sit on each row

item_icons.note: Every item id has a painted icon from sheets 05, 06 and 10, in the pack and loot windows

hud_minimal.note: Six bars and several text lines top-left, plus a key-help panel
